requirements.title: Support 20 Hz Altimeter Sampling
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall deliver pressure samples at 20 Hz.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-008; library throughput must support the system-mandated 20 Hz altimeter sample rate.

requirements.title: Report Pressure in Pascals
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall report pressure measurements in pascals.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units throughout requires pressure to be expressed in pascals.

requirements.title: Report Temperature in Degrees Celsius
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall report temperature measurements in degrees Celsius.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units throughout requires temperature to be expressed in degrees Celsius.

requirements.title: Report Derived Altitude in Meters
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall report a derived altitude measurement in meters.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units throughout requires altitude to be expressed in meters; reference frame defined in design.

requirements.title: Power-On Self-Test Device Probe
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall report at startup whether the altimeter device is present and responsive.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-029; POST requires probing each sensor device once at startup including the barometric altimeter.

requirements.title: Continuous Altimeter Health Reporting
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall publish a health indicator reflecting whether device samples are flowing.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031; continuous per-sensor health bitmap requires the library to surface its data-flow state.

requirements.title: Read Failure Status Reporting
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall return a failure status code when a read from the altimeter fails.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-058; explicit failure status enables the caller to flag sensor unhealthy. Status return enables the caller to satisfy SYS-033 continuation.

requirements.title: Non-Blocking Read Interface
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall provide a non-blocking read interface that returns within a caller-supplied timeout.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic execution requires the library never to block the TDM scheduler indefinitely.

requirements.title: POSIX Implementation Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall provide a POSIX implementation functionally equivalent to the Pico2 implementation.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation requires POSIX builds that exercise the same library API as flight.

requirements.title: Pico2 Implementation for Flight Hardware
requirements.description: The barometric altimeter library shall provide a Pico2 implementation that reads samples from the flight altimeter device.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; flight hardware build requires a Pico2 implementation paired with the POSIX implementation.
